previous_assumption: The recentDecisions/matched packing loops could safely break on the first record that did not fit the token budget, since later candidates would only be smaller in typical use
correction: A field audit on a 1,919-commit production repo found the opposite: one oversized decision sorted first silently zeroed out every smaller decision after it via break, making truncated:true fire on every single brief call regardless of scope. Fixed to continue (skip, keep packing) in both loops — confirmed by reproducing the exact reported pattern (tokenEstimate well under budget, truncated true, decisions missing) before and after the fix
